UpdateOp.doc: Discriminator for the row-mutation kind that triggered an update_hook / preupdate_hook fire. Numeric codes (Delete=9, Insert=18, Update=23) match mainline SQLite's authorizer action codes for FFI parity; targets MAY but need not expose the integer form.

UpdateNotification.doc: Argument passed to update_hook callbacks (master.md Pin 3-5). Fires AFTER row mutation, BEFORE commit. rowid is the affected row's integer primary key (synthetic if implicit). schema is 'main', 'temp', or an attached schema name.

RowAccessor.doc: Lazy column-value accessor passed to preupdate_hook for old / new row payloads. Targets render this as the most idiomatic per-language read surface (Rust struct with `get(col_idx) -> Value`, C function pair `preupdate_old(db,col,&out)` / `preupdate_new(db,col,&out)`, Python list-like, Go struct with method, Zig struct + method). The accessor is only valid for the duration of the callback; reading past return is undefined.

PreUpdateNotification.doc: Argument to preupdate_hook callbacks. Fires BEFORE row mutation. Pin 9: old_row is present for Update/Delete and absent for Insert; new_row is present for Update/Insert and absent for Delete. rowid_old equals rowid_new for Update unless the UPDATE rewrites the rowid; for Insert rowid_old is absent; for Delete rowid_new is absent.

CommitDecision.doc: Return value of commit_hook (Pin 6). Commit lets the transaction proceed to durability; Veto promotes the in-flight commit into a rollback and surfaces RuntimeCondition::CommitVetoed at the originating step.

OpaqueUserData.doc: Target-defined per-callback user-data handle (same shape as the authorizer's; the spec keeps them as separate types so target mappings may diverge if needed). Spec treats this as opaque.

CommitHookCallback.doc: Called by the transaction layer immediately before a commit becomes durable. Returns CommitDecision::Commit to proceed or Veto to roll back. MUST NOT call recursive prepare/step/DDL on the same db (Pin 12).

RollbackHookCallback.doc: Called by the transaction layer after a rollback completes. Return value (if any) is discarded. Same recursion restriction as CommitHookCallback.

UpdateHookCallback.doc: Called once per row INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on a non-system table, AFTER the in-memory page mutation, BEFORE commit (Pin 3). Return value discarded — update_hook cannot veto.

PreUpdateHookCallback.doc: Called once per row mutation on a non-system table BEFORE the mutation applies. Receives accessors for old / new row column values; the accessors are only valid for the lifetime of the call (Pin 9). Return value discarded — preupdate cannot veto.

CommitHookSlot.doc: Per-connection commit-hook slot. Both fields are present-or-absent together: setting a callback installs both, clearing removes both.

HooksState.doc: Aggregated hooks slot living on the Database connection record. The four sub-slots are independent (Pin 1).

HooksState.name: empty
HooksState.doc: Initial per-connection state — no hooks installed. All four fire_* entry points short-circuit to no-op / Commit.

set_commit_hook.doc: Install / replace / clear the per-connection commit-hook. Pass absent for callback + user_data to clear. Returns the prior user_data handle (mainline parity); targets MAY drop the return if their idiomatic surface prefers a void set.

set_rollback_hook.doc: Install / replace / clear the per-connection rollback-hook. Same shape as set_commit_hook.

set_update_hook.doc: Install / replace / clear the per-connection update-hook. Replacement mid-transaction means rows mutated before the replacement fired the prior callback; rows after fire the new one (no callback list).

set_preupdate_hook.doc: Install / replace / clear the per-connection preupdate-hook. Independent of update_hook (Pin 1); both may be installed and both fire as a pair (Pin 10).

fire_commit.doc: Transaction-layer-internal entry point. Called immediately before a commit's durability barrier. Returns CommitDecision::Commit if no commit_hook is installed; otherwise invokes the callback and returns its verdict. The transaction layer maps Veto to: revert in-memory pages, do not write WAL/journal commit record, fire_rollback, surface RuntimeCondition::CommitVetoed at the originating step (master.md Pin 6).

fire_rollback.doc: Transaction-layer-internal entry point. Called after rollback completes (in-memory pages reverted, WAL/journal rolled back). No-op if no rollback_hook installed. Pin 8.

fire_update.doc: VDBE-internal entry point called by Insert/Update/Delete opcodes AFTER the row mutation applies to in-memory page state. No-op if no update_hook installed; no-op if table is a sqlite_* system table (Pin 5). Pin 4: one fire per row, in mutation order.

fire_preupdate.doc: VDBE-internal entry point called by Insert/Update/Delete opcodes BEFORE the row mutation applies. No-op if no preupdate_hook installed; no-op for sqlite_* system tables (Pin 13). The accessors are constructed by the VDBE on demand and remain valid only for the duration of this call.
